payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation in the HiStruct+ model.

claims.text: The paper incorporates section titles into the BOS representation by using section title embeddings (STE) and classified section title embeddings (classified STE).
Section titles are encoded and injected into the sentence representations to provide hierarchical structure information for summarization tasks.
The section title embeddings are generated by summing the last hidden states of the tokenized section title in the TLM.
Classified STEs are used when section titles belong to predefined classes, enhancing the representation of similar section titles.
